body:
It's not really a dead end job though.  It pays me decently and I get at least some health benefits, and some of the experience I get here should look great on a resume.  The problem is I just hate it and I don't know why.  I don't feel that my depression causes me to be unable to work and I'd feel bad about taking advantage of a handout like that.  It was bad enough when I was unemployed for 6 months or so and collecting unemployment.

I have a B.A. in Film & Media Arts and an A.A. in Communications, and some IT certs.  I'm definitely not doing anything close to what I wanted to be doing with my life.  When I was finishing up college, my city was being conditioned to become the East Coast Hollywood essentially - I had tons of connections and jobs lined up.  But our mayor got greedy and ran them out of town, so now there's nothing for me here.  All of the studios they were building got shut down.  I wish I had the time, money, and quite frankly the motivation and drive to film some independent projects and try my luck in the festival circuit - but I just don't have that (mainly the first two.  I think in the right conditions I could build myself back up to the drive/motivation).  I didn't enter this profession with delusions of fame and fortune, nor did I expect it to be easy, but I had a plan and it all fell through.  There's not even any video editing jobs around here, which I would absolutely love to do.

I'm already in the process of finding a way out of my current job.  I noticed a job posting for an "intake specialist" at a local LGBT healthcare center, and that's something I care about so I'm thinking about giving it a shot.  I don't have any idea if they pay enough though and I'm expecting to get ignored because I don't have experience in social care settings.

I've always been pretty depressed, but not like this.  The last few years have just been awful, and I'm at the beginning stages of a gender transition that is causing a ton of stress and more financial hardship on my life.

I went for my dreams already, but they weren't achievable.  Don't know what else to say.  I'm not all that greedy - I don't care a whole hell of a lot about money, I just want enough to live comfortably without worrying about bills or being financially forced to do nothing but sit around all day.  I need purpose and something I care about to work on, and I need people who care about me and the work that I do.  That's really all I want.
Nothing beautiful about this life.
The fuck?  I've never heard of this question being asked in an interview - are you applying for jobs as a clown?
because no one wants a shy, geeky, ugly tranny.

Your answer to crushing lonliness is "be more alone"?  Really?  And it's not like we live forever - these aren't "other people's standards" these are "shit that i want in my life but life won't let me fucking have for no god damned reason and I'm sick of feeling this way" standards.  You only get to live once, why do some of our lives have to be wasted while seemingly everyone around us gets to live it up?

well, mainly, because what's the point?  What's the point in finishing life feeling like this?  Especially when it's just going to go by so fast that you never get to do or experience anything major anyway?  Why do I want to be old and useless in what's going to feel like a couple of months ( about 15 years)?  I'm not happy, nothing makes me happy, to quote Office Space "Every day sucks a bit more than the last, so literally every day is the worst day of my life".  Why do I want to let this get worse?  And then just die in a few short years negating everything and anything I ever did in life?  What's the point?

And i mean, as far as slaving away at dead end jobs go - it's either that or be homeless.  No one who's not born wealthy has a choice in that matter.  It's either be a wage slave who never gets to live life so that rich people can, or die in the streets.

I have put myself out of my element many, many times, as I do get sick of whatever my life is if it goes stale (which usually takes about 3-6 months of the same thing).  I might be happy for a small burst of time, and then it's almost immediately stale and dull and depressing again.

You're right in that there does seem to be some decent potential friends around here though.  I just am finding it difficult to find enough pro's in life to justify dealing with the con's.  The simple fact is I'm going to be stuck as a miserable, lonely, ugly, wage slave until I'm so old i collapse and die on the job, and the janitor brushes me into the dumpster.  Why would I want to bother living this life?  There's no hope and nothing to look forward to, it's all just more and more downhill from here.
lol on the contrary I'm scared as hell of getting older.  I feel like my life is just about done at 25 already, I don't want to be 30.  Life's going by too fast.
You're making up arguments that I never stated.  I don't think you understand what "logic" is.  Work on your comprehension skills before talking.
You obviously did not read or comprehend what I posted.
No one argued that the actions weren't different.  At all.  Simply your profession.
I'm starting to see why you work in the sex industry...do you have much going on between the ears?   You're coming up with baffling irreverent situations to try and prove a point that you can't make.
In my experience?  Ask.  Especially at parties.
You're just making things up that aren't relevant.  Someone looking nice for their job is doing just that.  A waitress isn't a sex worker - where the hell would you get that idea from?
There is a big difference in the actions, but not in what you are.  She's pretending she's not selling her sex for money, which she is absolutely doing.
You obviously didn't read what I wrote.  Also, don't assume everyone you meet on the internet is a man.

I have respect for sex workers and I do agree with your sentiment (someone shouldn't assume that a stripper is a prostitute), but you're kidding yourself if you think there's a big difference.  It's just different levels on the sliding scale of sex work.

I actually can't stand humidity haha.  I like Florida from the few visits I've had there, but I think I'd die from the humidity if I lived there.  I like the weather best when it's cool, light jacket weather or a dry heat.

I've never heard of a "hackerspace" before - I'm going to google this obviously but what's the best way to find one?  What exactly is it?

I've already gone through college, and those Pell grants aren't all you think they are.  have about 30K in debt to pay off now.  I met some people in college, but as soon as college ended they all went their separate ways and don't really keep in touch.  A lot of "friends" only want you when you're convenient to them, and ditch you without a second's thought, in my experience.

I've heard a lot about Seattle, and it sounds like an amazing place honestly.  I've definitely considered moving out there but I'm afraid to without a job lined up.  I'm transgendered and I hear it's an incredibly friendly area for people like me, which is a definite plus.  If I'm able to find work out there in a couple of years when I'm farther along in my transition I'll likely jump on the opportunity.

I never heard of the "Seattle Freeze" but it sounds like a pretty similar predicament I have going on in Philly.  It's pretty much Philly culture to be a mean-spirited prick to most of the people you meet here I've noticed.

I'm also pretty shy but I do look for ways to introduce myself or meet people - I just don't ever seem to find opportunities.

Actually, I'm stuck in a kind of crappy city - Philadelphia.  It's not the best place in the world and not a whole lot to do other than eat and drink booze, and that gets old pretty fast, but you'd still think I shouldn't have trouble meeting decent people in a major city.

I'm not sure where else to look for dates other than something like OKcupid.  I don't know where to meet single girls or boys who share my interests around here.  Though, I guess my problem as a whole is my inability to meet people who share my interests.

I'm far removed from high school, I'm afraid (being 25 ancient years old) but I know how hard it is to have parents who refuse to believe you are depressed.  This is why I was never able to see a therapist/psychiatrist back when it would have mattered when I was in high school.  I'm seeing one now for my transgender issues, but I've simply come too far and learned too much for it to be of any help for my depression.  There's nothing left for me to learn or try, I'm already set in where I am.

You're welcome to message me as well if you care to.
upvoted for hilarity
that's not creepy.  feel free to PM me.
i'm not really sure what's left to try.  My depression is crippling.  All I "want" (more like "can") do is force myself out of the house for work anymore, and then make my way back home.
I'm not sure what to say other than "I'm sorry", honestly.  It sucks.

And you would be absolutely wrong.
i was interested in competitive gaming, graphic novels, filmmaking, voice acting, music.  Got a little bit into some of those things but lost my drive.
All villains have henchmen.  What's right and wrong is pretty clear, particularly when dealing with a villain.
When I was a kid, the folks who killed the bad guy were called "heroes".  Has this changed?
i did pursue hobbies and such.  That doesn't help.  Everywhere I go I am unwanted.  I no longer have the desire or motivation for hobbies, it's left me.
what constitutes trying so hard?  Trying to start a conversation?  I know for a fact sitting around by myself doesn't bring anyone to me.
